name: Heriot-Watt University Malaysia

Wikipedia page for parent university with campus in Putrajaya, Malaysia since 2012. Offers undergraduate and master's degrees.

notes: Branch campus of Heriot-Watt University (UK). Campus opened in Putrajaya in 2014. First green campus in Malaysia. Offers foundation, undergraduate and postgraduate programmes based on UK curriculum.
